description: This file defines a PHP interface 'AuthParamsInterface' within the OrangeHRM authentication DTO namespace. It specifies two methods for retrieving user credentials and authentication attributes, which can be nullable, indicating optional return values.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Returns the user credential object or null if none are set.

methods.name: getAttributeBag
methods.description: Returns the authentication attribute bag or null if none are set.
